purpose: Map Restaurant operational charge meaning to existing Neutral Finance contracts without creating financial truth or a parallel ledger.
capabilities: delivery/takeaway fee mapping through governed customer-service-fee revenue nature
restaurant report plans over Neutral Finance/SO9
charge_formula: gross = R1 base lines + positive R2 modifier snapshots; collectible_before_tip = gross - discounts - complimentary + customer_service_fees + output_tax; customer_due = collectible_before_tip + tips
invariants: SO1 prices are consumed as historical operational snapshots, not re-priced by R3
provider fees are not customer service fees
pre-financial cancel/void may remain operational only
post-financial cancellation must become Finance correction/refund semantics
anonymous/walk-in obligation requires a resolved Party identity from existing authority
WND time/commission/payment-method rules remain tenant/template configuration
R3 produces no financial database writes
